name: PrMarketingChatAgent
description: Chat with it to learn, in plain English, what the product team has shipped or is building (from the product docs and Jira), then get on-brand LinkedIn/X posts, blogs, release notes and emails, Calfus-branded social images (.png + editable .pptx) and blog documents (.docx + .pdf). Drafts are fact-checked against the sources and need human review before publishing.

triggers.name: requirement
triggers.description: Your message, e.g. "What shipped in the last two weeks?" or "Write a LinkedIn post about the new Jira connector".
